artboards.title: Jump to a comment's original diff

annotations.text:
Open questions:
· commit panel: show parent links as navigation?

Diff scope model:
· All changes: main → branch tip, with a '+ working tree' toggle to fold uncommitted changes in (off = committed only).
· By commit: each commit vs its parent; working tree is the last step. Comments carry the pair they were made on.

Threads model (settled):
· inline threads in the diff are primary
· Conversation tab aggregates every thread chronologically — review-level, file-anchored (with quoted lines + jump link), resolved (collapsed), outdated (jump opens the original diff).
· Browse comments anchor to a file@ref, no diff pair.
· Browse's 'viewing' picker offers any ref — branch, tag, commit, worktree (the daemon's tree snapshots already take an arbitrary RefSpec).

Keyboard (settled):
· terminal-safe, modifier-light: bare keys; only ctrl+enter (submit) uses a modifier; GUI ⌘ aliases second in tooltips
· zellij-style: flat keys for the main flow (j/k · n/p · enter · c/r · v · x · t/F/: palette · / · 1/2/3 · tab · Esc · ?); ONE leader 'g' for the rest — pressing g switches the hint bar to the group (g a/g c scope · g w worktree · g s/g h layout/whitespace · g f/g F files · g < > = resize), Esc cancels
· no global vim modes: text inputs and a pending leader are the only key-capturing states
· ~/.config/moor/keys.toml rebinds per context incl. leader groups; bad entries fail loudly; hints, ? help and tooltips re-derive (one source of truth); every control is a mouse alias for a chord
· same core keymap drives web, Tauri and the TUI
